 2026 DI women's soccer championship: Bracket, schedule, scores
 DI women's soccer: 2026 selection show 
 Share 
 Here’s everything you need to know about the 2026 NCAA DI women's soccer selection
 The full 64-team championship field for the single-elimination tournament was revealed during a selection show live streamed here on NCAA.com. 
 Thirty one conferences received automatic bids, with the remaining teams selected at-large — teams must have an overall win-loss record of .500 or better. Click or tap here for the press release.
